ov: كل شيء هادىء على الجبهة الغربية (الإنجليزية: All Quiet on the Western Front) هو فيلم دراما تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وصدر في سنة 1930. الفيلم من إخراج لويس مايلستون، وهو مأخوذ عن رواية كل شيء هادىء على الجبهة الغربية لإريك ماريا ريمارك
plotEn:
In a German village during the early stages of The Great War, Professor Kantorek gives an impassioned speech to his students about the glory of defending their country. The boys, led by Paul Bäumer, enthusiastically enlist in the Imperial German Army and are cruelly trained by Sergeant Himmelstoss, formerly a friendly mailman now corrupted by his authority. 
The new soldiers arrive in a destroyed town on the Western Front and assigned to the 2nd Company, where they are mentored by Corporal "Kat" Katzinsky about the harsh realities of the war. Paul and his friends are first tasked with re-rigging the barbed wire on the frontline; Behn is blinded by an artillery strike and then killed by gunfire. The unit is eventually rotated to a frontline trench, where Paul and his squad shelter in a dugout and endure several days of heavy bombardment and starvation. The terror and stress overwhelms many of the men, and Kemmerick is severely wounded when he flees the dugout in panic. The company then repels a massive attack by the French Army; Paul and his squad barely survive. 
When the company is finally relieved and fed proper rations, the men ponder on what caused the war and the petty justifications for the fighting. Paul and his friends then go to visit Kemmerick in the hospital, who eventually dies. More of Paul's friends and schoolmates are killed or wounded as time passes, shattering his innocence and any romantic notions about the war.
